decision: Selected the area centroid of the Catastro INSPIRE building footprint ES.SDGC.BU.4785302DF2748F (office use, 2024, one building unit, 13,583 m2 gross floor area; nine polygon parts) on parcel 4785302DF2748F. Equinix publishes BA2 at 'Carretera del Mig 219, L'Hospitalet de Llobregat'; Catastro's street register has no number 219 on CR MIG DEL and returns the nearest number 217 on this parcel, while the official Catalan geocoder (ICGC) has a portal 219 whose point lies inside this parcel and inside this building footprint (portals 221 and higher fall outside). positional_accuracy: Catastro states horizontalGeometryEstimatedAccuracy 0.1 m for the building footprint; the point is a derived interior anchor.
